source_scope: Current active managed release only; persisted local observations, including replay loops.

visual_review.comparison_method: Matched the locally reviewed crop to its persisted plate-read observation using camera, session, frame, and crop bounding box; compared canonicalized character strings.
visual_review.review_scope: One selected crop per camera-local tracker identifier in the sampled set. Replay-loop and physical-vehicle independence are not established.
visual_review.local_review_packet: backend/data/review/cam07-09-groundtruth-template.json (git-ignored; contains reviewer transcriptions and crop/source metadata)

limitations: Three readable crop labels were compared and all three persisted raw OCR strings differed from the reviewer transcription; this tiny selected set is not a representative accuracy estimate.
Five unreadable and one uncertain crop were excluded from exact-string comparison.
Track groups are application-generated and may split one physical vehicle.
Counts include repeated reads across replay loops.
No readable negatives, detector misses, independent vehicle/session splits, or held-out labels are measured.

offline_preprocessing_probe.purpose: Check whether simple crop transforms or additional frame context recover exact OCR on the three reviewed readable crops.
offline_preprocessing_probe.result: No tested variant produced an exact match on this three-crop set. No preprocessing change was promoted to the live pipeline.
limitations: Exploratory, selected crops only; these counts do not estimate general OCR accuracy.
Higher OCR confidence on transformed images did not establish correctness.

followup_review.comparison_method: Matched the reviewed crop to its persisted plate-read observation using camera, session, frame, and bounding box; compared canonicalized character strings.
followup_review.selection_scope: Four additional candidate crops per camera, selected from active-source observations by the existing unvalidated image-review heuristic, excluding earlier reviewed crop hashes and spacing selected offsets by at least two seconds.
followup_review.limitation: This one reviewed follow-up crop is not representative and does not estimate OCR accuracy.
